name: Rock & Blues Drum Patterns
description: The most common rock and blues drum grooves, one per row (1-9, A-E). Every groove row holds three one-bar patterns in the 10-bar form A-B-A-B-C-A-B-A-B-B: A the main groove, B a variation, C a fill, with a crash launched on the bar after the fill. Rows F-P are shared layers (hats, ride, kick, crash) the grooves launch with @name&. Row 0 tours all fourteen. Written to show MPL features: calls, counted calls, launches, nested loops, bare repeats, rests, durations, feel marks (sticky and per note), exclusive # groups. Drums are GM notes on ch 10 with absolute octave digits so the default-octave setting cannot move them.
prompt: a MPL bank of the most common rock and blues drum patterns, 3 patterns per slot in the form A-B-A-B-C-A-B-A-B-B, as an exercise to demonstrate the features of MPL

slots.name: drumTour
slots.note: MAIN: every groove once, 10 bars each (140 bars). MPL: @name CALLS inline a slot and return; # makes this exclusive, so starting any single groove stops the tour; the | after slowBlues sets the feel back to dead straight.

slots.name: rock8
slots.note: ROCK straight 8ths. A kick 1, 3, &3 · B kick 1, &1, &3 · C snare-to-tom fill. MPL: the form 2((A),(B)),(C),@crash&,2((A),(B)),(B) = A-B-A-B-C-A-B-A-B-B; N( ) loops nest; 4D2s = bare note repeat.

slots.name: fourFloor
slots.note: ROCK four on the floor: this row is only the kick; snare on 2 and 4 with open-hat offbeats is the launched layer backHat. MPL: @name& LAUNCHES a part as its own voice — the only way two drums sound at once.

slots.name: halfTime
slots.note: ROCK half-time: snare only on 3. MPL: R rests with durations (Rq, Re).

slots.name: drive8
slots.note: ROCK driving 8ths: kick on 1 & and 3 &. MPL: e = eighth, q = quarter, s = sixteenth.

slots.name: ballad16
slots.note: ROCK ballad with 16th hats and a syncopated kick. MPL: the hat layer is 10@h16bar — a counted CALL of a one-bar subroutine.

slots.name: tomGroove
slots.note: ROCK floor-tom groove, snare on 2 and 4, kick on every beat from the launched kick4.

slots.name: boDiddley
slots.note: ROCK Bo Diddley beat (3-2 clave on the toms: 1, a-of-1, &-of-2, &-of-3, 4). MPL: Rs sixteenth rests place hits between the eighths.

slots.name: train
slots.note: ROCK / rockabilly train beat: snare 16ths, kick on 1 and 3, pedal hat on 2 and 4 from pedal24. MPL: a loop inside a pattern inside the form — three levels of nesting.

slots.name: chiShuffle
slots.note: BLUES Chicago shuffle. MPL: FEEL marks — a backslash lays a note 1/24 beat behind; four on an off-beat eighth land it on the last triplet. The fill is real triplets: s, s + 2 marks, e + 4 marks.

slots.name: texShuffle
slots.note: BLUES Texas (double) shuffle: the snare plays the shuffle itself. MPL: TWO launches (@kick4&@rideShuf&) run beside this row — three voices from one key.

slots.name: slowBlues
slots.note: BLUES slow 12/8: three hat triplets per beat from h12, kick pickup on the last triplet of 3. MPL: the lone backslash near the start is a STICKY feel mark — every note of this row sits 1 tick behind the hats (a laid-back pocket); notes with their own marks override it.

slots.name: halfShuffle
slots.note: BLUES-ROCK half-time shuffle: shuffled hats, snare on 3.

slots.name: rhumba
slots.note: BLUES rhumba: kick on 1, &-of-2 and 4, side stick on 2, tom answer on 3. Straight 8ths.

slots.name: boogie
slots.note: BLUES boogie / jump two-beat under a shuffled ride.

slots.name: h8bar
slots.note: LAYER subroutine: one bar of closed-hat 8ths. MPL: 8F#2e = bare repeat count on one note.

slots.name: h8
slots.note: LAYER: ten bars of 8th hats. MPL: N@name = counted call (subroutine of a subroutine).

slots.name: h16bar
slots.note: LAYER subroutine: one bar of 16th hats.

slots.name: h16
slots.note: LAYER: ten bars of 16th hats.

slots.name: hShuf
slots.note: LAYER: ten bars of shuffled hats — each off-beat eighth carries 4 feel marks, so it lands on the last triplet.

slots.name: h12
slots.note: LAYER: ten bars of hat triplets (12/8). MPL: per-note feel marks, 2 and 4 ticks behind.

slots.name: rideShuf
slots.note: LAYER: ten bars of shuffled ride.

slots.name: kick4
slots.note: LAYER: kick on every beat for ten bars.

slots.name: backHat
slots.note: LAYER: snare on 2 and 4 with open-hat offbeats, ten bars.

slots.name: pedal24
slots.note: LAYER: pedal hi-hat on 2 and 4, ten bars.

slots.name: crash
slots.note: ONE-SHOT: crash cymbal, launched (@crash&) on the bar after each fill.
